Are TradeHQ's free trading courses any good?

TradeHQ offers 6 structured course tracks with 26 lessons, quizzes, cited sources and completion badges. AI-assisted additions receive an editorial review before publication. The free $100,000 virtual account supports spot instruments; derivatives exercises are conceptual.

What you will actually be able to do

Explain options-chain fields and calculate hypothetical defined-risk spread payoffs

Explain futures margin, contango and backwardation using contract worksheets

Identify economic releases and describe limits of interpreting market reactions

Examine cognitive biases through fictional decision records without diagnosing individuals

Compare hypothetical sizing assumptions and optional review records

How the courses work
1
Pick a track

Choose the topic that matches your level. Beginners typically start with Trading Psychology or Macro Reading.

2
Read the lesson

Check each lesson’s reading-time estimate. Read the worked examples, assumptions and linked sources at your own pace.

3
Take the quiz

A 4–6 question knowledge check. Explanations for every answer — you learn from mistakes.

4
Work through an example

Practise supported spot trades with virtual cash. For options and futures, calculate hypothetical contract payoffs and margin changes in a worksheet.

5
Earn the badge

Complete every lesson in a track to record a completion badge in this browser. Clearing browser storage can remove this progress; it is not a permanent profile credential.

Why you can trust this content
Educational only — no financial advice

TradeHQ is not a brokerage. Every lesson explicitly notes that scenarios are illustrative and that past simulated performance does not predict future real-world returns.

Sources and limitations

Each authored lesson has a source list. Sources support specified definitions and examples, not claims about returns. Always check a source date for time-sensitive financial rules.

Publisher and review process

TradeHQ identifies its creator and maintains course material for educational purposes. AI-assisted additions require an owner publication review; this does not imply an independent financial-professional endorsement.

Practice, not preaching

Use $100,000 virtual cash to practise supported spot instruments and general trading habits. Options and futures contract mechanics are taught through worked examples; TradeHQ does not execute derivatives contracts.

About the author

TradeHQ course material is maintained by Anuga Weerasinghe, the creator of TradeHQ. TradeHQ is a free educational simulator built for self-directed learners — especially students in emerging markets — who want to explore market concepts through hypothetical examples.

AI-assisted additions identify their preparation and owner publication review on the course page. This review does not imply independent financial-professional verification. Lessons link their public sources for the scope described. If you spot an error, please contact us — reported corrections are reviewed before publication.

Important risk information

Trading real financial instruments involves substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for every investor. Nothing on TradeHQ constitutes a recommendation to buy or sell any security.

Simulated results shown in these courses do not represent real trading. They do not account for real-world slippage, spreads, commissions, taxes, funding costs, gap risk, or the emotional impact of trading with real money. Past simulated performance is not a reliable indicator of future real-world results.

Before making any real investment decision, consult a licensed financial professional in your jurisdiction.
